name: Pyromancer Breath of Neltharion disarms enemies in its cone (#3734)
contract: #3734: Breath of Neltharion (511109) is already native: TRIGGER_SPELL 301235 (Melt Weapon: disarm main hand, off hand and ranged for 6000 ms) on TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_104, radius 10 yd. An enemy 3 yd in front is disarmed, one 15 yd away is not. Targets are entry 46 (Murloc Forager, creature_equip_template main hand 1897): SpellInfo::CheckTarget (SpellInfo.cpp, Mechanic == MECHANIC_DISARM) rejects a disarm on a target with no equipped weapon (SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_NO_WEAPONS), so an unarmed dummy such as Harvest Golem (36) can never be disarmed. A target behind the caster cannot be placed by the harness (creature distance is X-only, min 0), so the rear side of the cone is not covered.

steps.label: Nothing is disarmed before the cast
Enemy in the cone is disarmed by Melt Weapon (301235)
Melt Weapon lasts at most its 6000 ms duration
Melt Weapon has a real remaining duration
Enemy beyond the 10 yd cone radius is not disarmed
